scope: Training-only feature preparation; no new model quality metrics

features.fractional_watches: sum min(accepted canonical airing seconds/canonical airing duration,1)
features.active_days: number of distinct arithmetic source days with an accepted canonical airing; day defined by last clipped positive overlap end minus1 microsecond; union across channels

acceptance: Original120s per canonical airing, fragments/views unioned, conflicting labels excluded, threshold before transforms, original seconds/watches must match prepared exports exactly
limits: Raw DB read-only; only training view times before each frozen cutoff; source/data hashes checked; no weeks31–42 viewing
